landmarks.name: Sanctuary threshold
landmarks.description: Roots and fallen leaves give way to weathered limestone.

landmarks.name: Dry gallery
landmarks.description: Directional walls frame gravel, cracks and small deposits of fallen stone.

landmarks.name: Raised shelf
landmarks.description: A worn ramp rises through the open notch in the limestone ledge.

landmarks.name: Reflecting grotto
landmarks.description: Seepage and rippling streams collect in a pool bordered by damp stone.
